EN: Strange radio signals have been emitting from Vault 93. Sounds like old sports broadcasts from before the bombs dropped. Go check it out!
ZH: 从93号避难所传来了奇怪的无线电信号。听起来像是大爆炸之前的体育广播。

EN: There's a ruckus in the nearby graveyard. Maybe someone needs your help, or there is something useful for you to scrounge up. Scoot on over there and check it out.
ZH: 附近的墓地发生了骚乱，也许有人需要你的帮助，或者你可以去那里搜刮一些有用的东西。过去看看吧。

EN: We have a space for our new motel, but now we need stuff to put in it. Apparently, there's a Ghoul salesperson around who can help us out.
ZH: 我们有了新旅馆的地方，但现在需要东西往里放。显然附近有个尸鬼商人能帮我们。

EN: Wonderful! I, too, love to roll in bottle caps. Well, not really, they get stuck in my skin if I do that.
ZH: 太好了！我也喜欢在瓶盖里打滚。唔，其实不行，弄到皮肤里会很痛。

EN: It was a trap! Whoever Death is, he's sleeping... and the Vault 144 Dwellers believe that killing people will wake the Horseman up! We killed their Overseer, but we still need to find their Vault. If we're lucky, the Vault-Tec Archives will have its location...
ZH: 那是个陷阱！无论“死亡”是谁，他都在沉睡……而144号避难所的居民认为杀死人能让“骑士”醒来！我们杀了他们的监督者，但我们仍然需要找到他们的避难所。如果我们足够幸运，避难所科技的档案里应该会有它的位置……

EN: Anyone that goes near it disappears. I think it's haunted! Vault-Tec's local office might have more.
ZH: 任何走近它的人都消失了。我想它一定是闹鬼了！避难所科技当地的办公室应该会有更多的信息。

EN: The library caretaker told me someone named Herb Vest might know more about Vault 31. I can track him down at the old candy factory.
ZH: 图书馆管理员告诉我有一个叫赫伯韦斯特的人可能知道关于31号避难所更多的消息。我去旧的糖果厂应该能找到他。

EN: Reports are coming in from all over the Wasteland of a frightening creature known only as the Gobbler. We have to investigate!
ZH: 传闻说废土上有一个叫做高步勒的可怕生物肆虐。我们必须去调查一下！

EN: That “Miracle Serum” we were sold in Freeside got a bunch of us sick! Time to track down the one who sold it to us and get an explanation.
ZH: 我们在自由城买到的那瓶“奇迹血清”让我们好几个人病倒了！是时候去找到卖给我们的人要个说法了。

EN: Hi there, welcome to Slavers, a used clothing outlet! Are you here to donate, or are you just shopping?
ZH: 嗨，欢迎来到奴隶公司，二手服装特卖！您是来捐赠的，还是来选购的？

EN: The Snake Oil Salesman sent us to a rickety building in the so-called Westside of New Vegas. They won't be making any more “Miracle Serum” when we're done with them.
ZH: 那个卖蛇油的把我们派到新维加斯所谓“西区”的一栋摇摇欲坠的楼里。等我们收拾完他们，他们就再也造不出“奇迹血清”了。

EN: You're here to destroy our operation. I can see that… I won't stop you. In fact, I'll tell you where they are.
ZH: 你们是来破坏我们生意的。我看得出来……我不会阻止你们。事实上，我告诉你们他们在哪里。

EN: We've discovered the base of the raiders who have been enslaving hapless folks in Freeside, in a vault near New Vegas. But where are the slaves going?
ZH: 我们在新维加斯附近的一座避难所里，发现了在自由城奴役倒霉路人的掠夺者据点。但这批奴隶究竟被运往何方了？

EN: That was quite the bachelor party last night! Too bad the groom's missing today. Last we saw, he was being carried away by the hired entertainment. We have to bring him back, and quick. Let's avoid a repeat of New Year's Eve...
ZH: 昨晚的单身派对真不错！可惜今天新郎失踪了。最后一次看到他，已经被雇来娱乐的人拖走了。我们必须尽快把他带回来。让我们避免重蹈新年夜的覆辙……

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Apparently there's more to this story than meets the taste buds. This refreshing miracle beverage isn't so miraculous or refreshing after all, and the folks at the RobCo plant just may know the truth...
ZH: 显然这个故事并不只是满足味蕾。这令人耳目一新的神奇饮料也许并不是那么神奇或清新。而罗伯科工厂里的人或许知道真相……

EN: You found the holotape records of Maxson's Roughnecks, a Brotherhood of Steel team searching the Wasteland for technology. Track them down to discover their fate - starting at Vault 450!
ZH: 你发现了“麦克森硬汉小队”的全息磁带记录，这是钢铁兄弟会派去废土搜寻科技的小队。去追踪他们、查明他们的结局吧——就从450号避难所开始！

EN: Apparently there's someone with some administrative skill who was kidnapped by raiders. Let's get him out of there, and maybe in return he'll help us run our motel!
ZH: 显然有个有管理才能的人被掠夺者绑架了。让我们把他从那里救出来，也许作为回报他会帮我们经营旅馆！

EN: Everyone's in the Wasteland, looking for fame - who has time for stomping bugs? We have to beat Vault 404!
ZH: 所有人都在废土上，想要成名。谁有时间管这些虫子？我们必须打败404号避难所！

EN: We've discovered that someone is printing new editions of the Boston Bugle and making stars out of schlubs - we're destined for fame and fortune!
ZH: 我们发现有人在印刷新一期的波士顿号角报，想把蠢货们变成明星。我们才是注定为名利而生！

EN: We need to convince the Brotherhood of Steel that the Vault is worthy enough to be an outpost! Time to support the squad of soldiers at the RobCo Corporate Offices.
ZH: 需要让钢铁兄弟会相信我们的避难所值得成为一个哨所！是时候去支援罗伯科办公大楼里的那支士兵小队了。

EN: Coach wasn't in Vault 789, but the place did have a familiar, sour smell... We're following the stench to Sandra's Stationary Store!
ZH: 教练不在789号避难所，但这地方有种熟悉的酸腐味……顺着这股味道去桑德拉文具店吧。

EN: This is it, the end of the game! It's a bench-clearing brawl with Coach in the Dugout. Time to retire this washout, and claim Rackie Jobinson's Jersey for our own!
ZH: 就是这里，大结局了！在球员休息区跟教练来一场全线群架。是该让这个失败者退役，把罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫拿回来了！

EN: Okay, so that Radscorpion omelet was kind of gross. To make up for it, the chef proposes to make his trademark Deathclaw Wellington. All he needs is fresh Deathclaw meat, straight from their den (sunlight is said to alter the taste).
ZH: 好吧，辐射蝎蛋卷还是有点恶心的。为了弥补，大厨提议把威灵顿死爪作为他的招牌菜，他只需要深藏巢穴里新鲜的死爪肉就行（据说光照会破坏味道）。

EN: As Halloween approaches, the story of Vault 31 and its strange past is being told once again. But is the Vault really haunted, or is something else to blame? It's up to you to solve... The Mystery of Vault 31!
ZH: 随着万圣节临近，有关31号避难所的故事和它奇怪的过去再一次流传了起来。但是到底是避难所真的闹鬼，还是有其他的什么原因？31避难所之谜正等待你去解决！

EN: Could Coach be hiding out in the old pencil factory? Probably not. But we're going to look there anyway.
ZH: 教练会藏在旧铅笔厂吗？大概不会。但无论如何还是查看一下。

EN: Call it a gut feeling, but Coach may be taking a breather in the ruins of Holy Heart Hospital. If he's there, so is Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!
ZH: 就算是直觉吧，我看教练可能在圣心脏医院的废墟里歇脚。只要他在那儿，罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫也一定在！

EN: Still no Coach, and no Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. But he's close! I can sense it. Or maybe it's just his lingering B.O. In any event, it's time to search the Precious Paws Pet Store!
ZH: 还是没有教练或是棒球衫的影子。但他应该就在附近了！我能感觉到。还是说只是他的狐臭！无论如何，我们去搜搜宝贝爪爪宠物商店吧！

EN: Some newlyweds from a nearby settlement went to a secluded cave to “celebrate” in private. They haven't returned, and neither has the original rescue party! Maybe those rumors of Radscorpions are true after all. Better gear up!
ZH: 来自附近定居点的某对新婚夫妇去了一个偏僻的山洞“度蜜月”。他们至今未归，第一批救援队也一去不回！也许关于辐射蝎的传闻是真的。最好带上家伙！

EN: Abandoned Super-Duper Marts sometimes contain useful stuff. They also often serve as lairs for dangerous creatures. Be careful!
ZH: 废弃的大无敌超市有时候保存着有用的东西。它们通常也是危险生物的老巢。要当心！

EN: Raiders have been snatching up folks all over the Wasteland. Put an end to their scheme, and save their victims.
ZH: 掠夺者们在废土上到处欺负善良的人们。拯救那些受害者，终结这一切吧！

EN: Rumors have been circulating about a Vault with a pool, sauna, and even a hot tub! Search Vault 189 to find this oasis of relaxation, but beware of the ghoul infestation!
ZH: 有传闻说某个避难所里有一个水池，可以蒸桑拿，甚至泡热水澡！去189号避难所寻找这个让人放松休息的绿洲吧。但小心尸鬼！

EN: We're throwing a party for Mr. House, and we want all the most interesting people there. The only invite left to deliver is to Maximus! Find him on the Strip!
ZH: 我们要为豪斯先生办一场派对，想把所有最有趣的人都请来。最后一张请柬要送给马克西姆斯！去新维加斯大道上找他！

EN: Mr. House? Who's… uh, I mean, of course. Why wouldn't he want to meet me? I'm important! And talented!
ZH: 豪斯先生？他是……呃，我是说，当然。他怎么会不想见我？我可是大人物！而且才华横溢！

EN: Securitrons are supposed to be excellent guards. Go see Victor at RobCo headquarters and discuss security for Mr. House's party.
ZH: 保安机器人本该是出色的守卫。去 罗伯科 总部见维克托，讨论豪斯先生派对的安保事宜。

EN: They say there's a big Ghoul party happening nearby. Could be a good place to scout staff for Mr. House's party.
ZH: 据说附近有一场大型尸鬼派对。说不定是个物色豪斯先生派对工作人员的好地方。

EN: Uh, sure. We're still on the clock for two more hours, though. You should get out, it's dangerous in here.
ZH: 呃，好啊。不过我们还有两个小时才下班呢。你们该出去，这里很危险。

EN: The time has come for Mr. House's party! But… what's that sound? Radroaches! Squish them all before the rest of the guests arrive!
ZH: 豪斯先生派对的时刻到了！可……那是什么声音？辐射蟑螂！在其余宾客到达之前，把它们统统踩扁！

EN: I'm mighty sorry the Securitrons aren't killin' these vermin. Unless they go after Mr. House o' course.
ZH: 很抱歉保安机器人没能干掉这些害虫。除非它们去找豪斯先生的麻烦，那当然例外。

EN: What a fabulous party. Reminds me of the shining old days, when Vegas was known the whole world over.
ZH: 多棒的派对啊。让我想起那段辉煌的旧时光，那时维加斯之名响彻全世界。

EN: Okay, so Holy Heart Hospital was a dead end. But at least we're still alive! Next stop, the ruins of Lakeville Library.
ZH: 好吧。所以圣心脏医院肯定是条死路了，但至少我们都还活着！下一站，莱克维尔图书馆。

EN: Jack's been through the ringer - and now he might get turned into dinner! Slavers sold him to a Potted Meat plant. We need to head there!
ZH: 杰克已经受过一次大惊吓——可现在他马上要成为别人的晚餐！奴隶贩子把他卖给了肉酱厂。我们应该去那里找他！

EN: There have been several reports of strange lights hovering over the Wasteland not far from here. The lights were congregating over an old abandoned mine. We need to investigate this before rumors of alien visitors start spreading!
ZH: 有好几份报告说，在离这里不远的废土上有奇怪的光在盘旋。灯光聚集在一个废弃的旧矿井上。我们需要在外星人入侵的谣言开始传播之前进行调查！

EN: If Coach has the Jersey, maybe he needs to keep it clean. We're off to search the BubblySuds Laundromat!
ZH: 如果教练手里有棒球衫的话，也许他需要保持干净。我们去泡泡多自助洗衣店看看吧！

EN: We've received a distress call from some Minutemen. Apparently some Ghouls have attacked one of their outposts. Help them out, and maybe they'll join our fight against the Institute!
ZH: 我们收到一些义勇军的求救信号。显然有一群尸鬼袭击了他们的一个前哨站。帮他们一把，说不定他们会加入我们对抗学院！

EN: Isn't it obvious? Maybe you're a Synth, too, and you're here to take me away and silence me. Please go.
ZH: 这还不明显吗？也许你也是个合成人，你是来抓我、让我闭嘴的。请走吧。

EN: The Covenant could be a helpful ally against the Institute. Use your natural charisma to get as many of them on board as you can.
ZH: 圣约村可以成为对抗学院的有力盟友。用你天生的魅力，尽可能多地说服他们加入。

EN: Hm. We can be pretty stubborn. Well, anyway, I've got to take care of something, so I'll meet you downstairs.
ZH: 嗯。我们可是出了名的固执。好吧，总之我有点事要处理，楼下见。

EN: Hmm… I really do hate the Institute. I'll find you some volunteers, but not a full-scale commitment.
ZH: 嗯……我确实恨学院。我会帮你找些志愿者，但不会全力投入。

EN: The Brotherhood needs us to retrieve some “secret blueprints” for them, from a RobCo research facility. If we do, they'll join our efforts, starting by give us some Fusion Cores!
ZH: 兄弟会需要我们替他们从一座罗伯科研究设施取回一些“机密蓝图”。只要办成，他们就会加入我们的行动，先给我们一些聚变核心作为回报！

EN: We've found where all the Synths have been coming from! An Institute base in an old Vault. Bring the fight to them, and hopefully stop the assault!
ZH: 我们找到了所有合成人的来源！一座老避难所里的学院基地。主动出击，但愿能阻止这场袭击！

EN: The Institute still stands and is attacking a nearby bunker. We've picked up a distress call with no details. Let's send a party to investigate.
ZH: 学院仍在活动，正袭击附近的一座地堡。我们收到一个没有详情的求救信号。派一队人过去调查吧。

EN: We were founded on compassion. Try to remember that. Be quick and get out, Synth reinforcements are coming.
ZH: 我们因恻隐之心而建立。记住这一点。动作要快，赶紧撤，合成人援军快到了。

EN: I'll leave that to you. I've lost enough friends today. But remember: they're human, even if built in a lab.
ZH: 这件事就交给你了。我今天已经失去了太多朋友。但请记住：它们是人类，即便是在实验室里造出来的。

EN: Whether we like it or not, we're involved with the Railroad now. They've asked for help freeing a group of reclaimed Synths.
ZH: 不管我们愿不愿意，我们现在已经和铁路组织扯上关系了。他们请我们帮忙解救一群被回收的合成人。

EN: The Brotherhood of Steel controls an antenna array that could scramble the Recall, which Coursers use to teleport. The Institute has taken notice.
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会控制着一座天线阵列，可以干扰追猎者用来传送的“召回”。学院已经注意到这件事。
